#!/usr/bin/env bash
bash tests/speckit-pro/layer1-structural/validate-plugin.sh
jq -r '.status' tests/speckit-pro/evidence.json
git bash --login
wsl.exe true
pwsh -File helper.ps1
cat results.json | grep status | sed 's/pass/ok/' | awk '{print $1}'
version=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import subprocess
os.system('echo unsafe')
subprocess.run('bash scripts/build-plugin-payloads.sh', shell=True)
subprocess.check_output('jq -r .version package.json')
PY
Maintainer history may mention `bash tests/speckit-pro/run-all.sh` and `jq` in prose.

jobs:
  validate:
    steps:
      - run: python3 -m speckit_pro_runner < tests/speckit-pro/unit/fixtures/runner-gates/requests/release-readiness.json
XPLAT-008 will cut over active Claude/Codex invocation surfaces that still reference bash helpers.

jobs:
  validate:
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch Python gate
        run: python3 -m speckit_pro_runner < tests/speckit-pro/unit/fixtures/runner-gates/requests/active-path-guard.json

jobs:
  release:
    steps:
      - name: Release plugin logic
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for manifest in */.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do
            jq -r '.version' "$manifest"
          done
          bash scripts/build-plugin-payloads.sh
